retrievalProfile.description: A glamorous pop-star portrait framed by a vintage circus-inspired border with arched, high-contrast display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a glamorous figure set against shimmering gold satin drapes, enclosed by a multi-layered border featuring a row of small blue stars. The composition is anchored by bold, arched display text in the lower third that mimics vintage carnival signage.
coreVisualRelationships: The arched main title follows the curve of the subject's lower body.
The star border creates a secondary internal frame that focuses attention on the face.
The warm gold background tones contrast with the cool cyan stars and vibrant red text.
The secondary title is centered at the bottom, flanked by decorative flourishes.
coreInvariants: Arched display typography in the lower foreground
A continuous border of five-pointed stars
High-key, warm lighting on the central subject
A primary color palette of red, gold, and cyan

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-close-up portrait, slightly angled, occupying the top two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold red arched text in the lower foreground acts as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move down the curve of the shoulder to the arched text, then circulate around the star border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with textured satin drapes and decorative elements.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan/Light Blue (stars and inner border line)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red and cyan elements against a high-value, luminous gold background.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high contrast between text and background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and decorative display
letterConstructionRules: Main title follows a convex upward arc
Letters feature a thick red fill with a bright gold/yellow outline
High stroke contrast with flared, decorative serifs
Secondary text is blocky, outlined, and straight-aligned
characterSpecificRedesigns: S and B characters have exaggerated, swash-like curves
Terminals are sharp and pointed to mimic carnival wood-cut styles
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A dramatic arched display serif paired with a smaller, blocky slab-serif for the subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the wood-block carnival aesthetic and flared serifs.
Offers the decorative, tall, western-circus feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a glamorous portrait of a person with blonde hair against a backdrop of shimmering gold satin curtains. Frame the image with a red outer border, a thin cyan line, and a row of small cyan stars inside the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a bold, arched red font with a gold outline in the lower third. Add a smaller subtitle below it in a blocky yellow font flanked by red decorative flourishes.

verificationChecks: Is the main text arched convexly?
Are the stars cyan and evenly spaced around the inner border?
Is the background texture clearly satin or silk?
Does the red text have a distinct gold outline?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the gold background glow
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text arc does not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the star border is complete on all four sides.
Ensure the gold satin has visible highlights and shadows.
Confirm the red and cyan colors are vibrant and not muted.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Satin Backdrop + Star Border Frame + Arched Carnival Typography = Vintage Pop Showman Aesthetic
